content: Abramjan tise pushei'ccu, pa'cco tise an'bian'choi'ccu Egipto ande'ye sombopa toequi Néguev andeni ja'fa. Tise quinshimbe du'shu Lot'qque fae'ngae tise'pai'ccu ja.
Abramjan ñoa'me rico. Nane cori, totoacori, tsain'bia vaura'can'ma'qque an'bian.
Néguevni japa cca'tti cca'tti can'jemba Betel canqqueni nepi'fa. Nane toequi tise'pa tayoe can'jeni japa can'jen'fa. Tsaja Betel, Hai canqque enttingeni.
Tse'ttinga tsu tayoeja Chiganga afeye oque'je'choma ccutsian. Tsa'camba tsu toe'ttingayi Na'su Chigama iñajan.
Toya'caen Lot'qque ñoa'me rico. Nane tise ton'ton Abram'caen osha'cho vaura, ovejama'qque an'bian. Toya'caen tsain'bio a'i tisei'ccu can'jen'fa.
Tsa'cansi tsu Abram, Loti'ccu can'jen'ttija ñoa'me on'ba'o. Nane shoshovi shacasi tsain'bio vaurama tseni fae'ngae o'fiañe oshambi. Tsa'camba ti'tsse tsa'caen fae'ngae can'jeñe osha'fambi.
Toya'caen Abram vaurama coirasundeccuja Lot vaurama coirasundeccui'ccu sepiccopa tssetssecco'fa.
Tsa'cansi fae a'ta Abramjan Lotma su: “Quei'ccuja antiandeccu gi. Tsa'cansi tsu ingi iyiccoyeja ega. Ni ingimbe coirasundeccu'qque tsa'caen iyicco'faye ega tsu.
Tsain'bitssi ande tsu jin manima in'jan'da ingi isuya'cho. Chigáne ña'ñe joqquitssija. Que tansinfanga ja'ninda gi ñajan pavefanga jaya. Tsambi'ta que pavefanga ja'ninda gi ñajan tansinfanga jaya.”

Tsa'caen susi Lotja pa'cco Jordán na'en'su andema camba tsama in'jan. Nane Zoar canqquepi tsu tsain'bio tsa'ccu jin. Nane ñoa'me ñotssia jombachoqquiacan'omba tsu Egipto andian'caeñi attian. Lot tsa'caen camba in'jainteja toya Na'su Chiga Sodoma canqque, Gomorra canqquema joqquitssian catimbi'te tsu.
Tsa'caen in'jamba Lotja Jordán na'en'su andeni jaye qquen supa tise'pa can'jen'tti'ye sombopa chiga sombo'jefanga ja. Tsa'caen tsu Abram, Lot'qque attufacco'fa.
Abram toya Canaán andeni can'jensi Lotja Jordán na'en jini'su canqqueni can'jeñe ja. Nane Sodoma canqque pporotsse tsu can'jen.
Tseni'su aindeccuja ñoa'me egae in'jamba Na'su Chigama chi'gapa osha'cho tson'choi'ccu egae tsincon'fa.
Lot tsa'caen jasi, Na'su Chigaja Abramnga su: “Que can'jene ñotsse canjan. Nane tansinfanga, pavefanga chiga sombo'jefanga, chiga amppi'jefanga'qque camba in'janjan:
Quenga gi afeya pa'cco que camba atte'cho andema. Tsangae qui queja, que omba'su dutssiyendeccu'qque va andema an'bian'faya.
Ña anttesi tsu tsendeccuja ande'su sisipa'caen tsain'bitssia've da'faya. Nane sisipafo'choma agattoye oshambiqquia'caen tsu que dutssiyendeccuja agatto'ma'sia've da'faya.
Tsa'cansi jangipa pa'cco ande bia'sunga attaja'sunga'qque jacamba canjan ña quenga afe'cho andema.”

Tsa'caen susi Abramjan pa'cco tise an'bian'choma ñoñamba Hebrón canqque pporotsse japa ccotta'cco'su roble quini'ccoccuni can'jen. Tseni'su na'suja Mamre tsu. Tseni can'jemba Abramjan Chiganga afeye oque'je'choma ccutsian Na'su Chigama iñajañe.
